established_causality.statement: Stage32 weight field is an independent causal owner of Knight catastrophic deformation.

falsified_generic_replacements.reason: Topology-local harmonic diffusion slightly improves some oracle error statistics but worsens actual motion and leaves unresolved components; local smoothness is insufficient.
Bone proximity is a useful diagnostic signal but not a sufficient semantic carrier authority; hard locality correction increases unsafe mechanics and teacher error.

measured_information_gap.interpretation: The dominant error is not isolated numerical noise. Large unsupported regions can form internally smooth, confident-looking but semantically wrong weight fields.

contract_consequence.conclusion: Numeric simplex qualification alone cannot promote free-running evidence-free rows to trusted product skin.

authorized_next_research: Direct mechanical-objective weight optimization with explicit fixed-evidence anchors and nontrivial anti-collapse constraints may be tested, but is not authorized as product repair.
Arachne evidence/support-confidence semantics and training coverage must be investigated because compiler-only smoothness/locality heuristics failed.
No Arachne retrain is authorized until the missing evidence/coverage contract and experiment are preregistered.
forbidden_promotions: Do not adopt plain graph harmonic completion.
Do not treat simplex validity as semantic skin validity.
Do not claim teacher-free weight oracle replacement is solved.
